links.outcome: Readability, understandability and actionability of AI-generated postoperative instructions
links.effect: FKGL was 9.07 (Gemini), 9.82 (DeepSeek) and 10.87 (ChatGPT). Understandability was 63.30-76.45% and actionability 45.15-58.5%. None met optimal standards for patient education.
links.quote: FKGL was lowest in Gemini (9.07), compared to DeepSeek (9.82) and ChatGPT (10.87) (p = 0.469).

screen.reason: Evaluates readability, understandability, and actionability of patient post-operative instructions generated by three LLMs (ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Gemini) without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
